name: ExecuteAuthoritativeCommand
authoritative_reads: current owning target/revisions/preconditions only for a never-before-committed command
guards: replay path runs before command preparation or owner reads
existing receipt requires exact command_id/type/request_hash equality; mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
existing receipt with exact companion result validates response schema/version/canonical JSON/SHA-256 before return
existing legacy receipt without an exact companion result returns IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE; absence never authorizes current-state reconstruction or owner re-execution
fresh authoritative target preconditions for new execution
required audit payload validates before persistence
newly committed receipt cannot commit without exactly one bounded exact replay-result snapshot
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; same committed id/type/hash returns the exact persisted prior response and performs no command preparation/owner mutation/audit. A legacy committed receipt whose exact prior response is unavailable fails explicitly with IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE. Command type/hash mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Replay never fabricates a response from mutable current state.
receipt_order: open keyed/verified connection -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> replay receipt check; if committed, validate exact result and return or fail unavailable without prepare -> otherwise current-state revalidation/no-change decision -> insert one receipt -> owner/participant writes when material -> lifecycle/evidence/audit when required -> canonicalize and insert one exact command_receipt_results row -> COMMIT
mutations: exact owning-domain rows/evidence/audit rows inside same UnitOfWork
revision_effects: owning contract controls revisions; failed/no-change command changes no domain revision
audit_action: exact owning packet registered action for material mutation; none for accepted semantic NO_CHANGE
post_commit_work: only owning command explicitly registered post-commit work; never hidden inside Foundation boundary
